name: trash (guytrash)

attributes.attribute: a British folkloric form of the Skriker
appears before death as a shaggy dog
appears before death as a cow

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The trash is a British folkloric figure. It is a form of the Skriker. This evil being appears just before death. It takes the shape of a shaggy dog, which is called the trash, or of a cow, which is called the guytrash.

okr.objective: Record the British folk figure the trash.
key_results: The trash is a form of the Skriker
As the trash it is a shaggy dog, as the guytrash a cow
